description:
*From [INKR Comics](https://comics.inkr.com/title/560-a-queen-s-love):*   
Marissa is admired by all of the men at Dawa University, including the popular Shin Shim-hae. However, her eyes are set on Lee Dae-sung, the only man who doesn't seem to care for her.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4307809), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/QeenNp0043), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1020004531), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/queens_love), ZzangComic
